HOTEL RULES

Dear guests, to ensure safety and comfort of the Hotel guests during their stay, we have clarified some guidelines

Guests are given to key card upon registration at the reception and are kindly asked to lock the rooms. Guests are required to handover their keys to the receptionist upon departure. If guests lose or do not return the key card they are obligated to pay the penalty of Rs. 500/-

Timing for Housekeeping 1:30pm to 3:30pm

Linen is changed every third day. Used towels are changed daily.

For your convenience hotel has arranged the parking in front of the hotel. Hotel takes no responsibility for any damage or loss of your vehicle on the parking.

For any damage caused by the guests to the hotel property, the guest is due to cover the cost of damage to the hotel.

All departures after 12 p.m. will be considered as late departure and additional cost of Rs. 1500/- will be charged.

It is not allowed to take out from the hotel the room inventory (pillows, blankets, towels)

NOTE: CHECK-IN TIME: 2:00 PM | CHECK-OUT TIME:12:00 NOON
